svg.aria-label: Method overview with real slices at every stage: two photograph families, their canonical and polar framings, two single-image priors, one cylindrical state, one reverse chain, and the cuttable asset
svg.text: Two or three unposed photographs per family, of different specimens → a product of two single-image diffusion priors over the slices of one cylindrical lattice. Every panel below is a real slice.
the framing every slice will have
polar strip 128×512 — the membranes are now parallel
stripes, and φ wraps: stationary, axis-aligned texture
A[r, φ, z] — both families are exact slices
longitudinal: two φ columns → the (s,z) plane
the carrier, sampled into the cylinder with its interior mask M
One reverse chain on that state
t0 = 0.3 T → 0, 100 DDIM steps · nothing is interpolated inside the chain
each family denoises its own slices
the columella is a strip to one family, a disc to the other
ILVR: pin its low-pass, σ = 16 px
above the tiling, below the texture
both families now agree on it
baked once, read at any angle
read at any plane, supervised or not
the oblique plane has no photograph

carrier · the watermelon is a loss, reported
